scenes: Hackers stole six point three billion dollar from Binance in under an hour.
Blockchain firms T R M Labs and Chainalysis linked it to North Korea on Thursday.
Attackers exploited an engineer laptop and EIP-7702 to drain hot wallets during the cyberattack.
Stablecoin providers froze two point eight billion dollars, but about three billion dollar vanished forever in the crypto heist.
Co-CEO Richard Teng vowed corporate funds will cover all customer losses from the security breach.
As withdrawals paused, Bitcoin crashed below eighty thousand dollars for the first time in a month following the exploit.
